audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits: Veigar has no escape pre-stacks and Pantheon owns levels 1-6; late he one-shots. Content layer describes this arc well.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[6].side is 'Skill' while content win[6] and the packet chart both say Veigar — the two layers disagree on the 2+ items row.
audit.why: Content and packet agree; only the full side needed moving, so no win[6] edit (it would be a no-op). why rewritten to match the Veigar verdict, grounded in his infinite P stacks and missing-health R execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits; the cage's stun cancelling your Aegis channel (missingInteractions) was unstated; spikes[1] advised to 'leap the wall with Aegis Assault positioning', which is not a thing — Aegis is a channel, not a leap, and dashing through the cage edge stuns you.
audit.why: Event Horizon is 20/18.5/17/15.5/14, R is 120/90/60 and scales with missing health; Riot text says the cage 'Stuns enemies that pass through', so a W-dash across the wall self-stuns. Grounded all of it; suspectNames 'Free Baleful Strike' in wants.foe[1] is a false positive — 'Free' is the adjective, the ability name is correct.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your E Aegis Assault like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Veigar E (Event Horizon): 20s at rank 1, 14s maxed — his one defensive tool. Only the cage EDGE stuns; never W-dash through the wall, and the stun cancels your Aegis mid-channel. - His R is 120s at rank 1, 60s at 3, executing missing health — don't linger low. - Your E is 22s; save it for the W-R burst.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: When he panic-casts, Aegis eats the Dark Matter and Q bolt from the front — hold it for that, not poke.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: If your Aegis expires inside cage range with his E still up, one edge-clip stun feeds his stacked R execute — leave first.

edits.before: Late Pantheon is a starting pistol: R the flank, stun the carry, block the counter — and let the team finish what the spear started.
edits.after: One landed cage one-shots you now — stacked AP plus the missing-health R execute doesn't care about your build. Group and force peel.

edits.before: At 6 you gain a hard all-in with Grand Starfall while Veigar's R Primordial Burst is a single-target execute that needs stack scaling to threaten you. Dive him before his stacks pile up; if he cages, hold your W to break line of sight or leap the wall with Aegis Assault positioning so his combo whiffs.
edits.after: At 6 you gain a hard all-in with Grand Starfall while Veigar's R Primordial Burst is a single-target execute that needs stack scaling to threaten you. Dive him before his stacks pile up; if he cages around you, stand still near the centre until it fades — dashing W through the wall stuns you and hands him his combo.

notes: phases[6].rating stays 6/10 though the side moved to Veigar — rating semantics unclear, left alone. suspectNames flag on wants.foe[1] is a false positive ('Free' + Baleful Strike).
